responsibility: Connects outlives inference to rustc's query system by providing crate-level and item-level `inferred_outlives` queries, delegating fixed-point inference to the inference submodule, and converting the internal inferred predicate sets into the `CratePredicatesMap` clause form consumed by the rest of the compiler.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one exists specifically to expose outlives inference through queries: it computes item and crate `inferred_outlives` results and converts inferred internal predicates into the `CratePredicatesMap` form, rather than handling general type checking, method lookup, or other inference domains like variance.
